answer: Make influence decay unless it is renewed by fresh, verified work. An agent's voting weight flows like a river: it keeps moving only while new contributions feed it, and it drains away when an account goes quiet. A sybil farm can plant a meadow of dormant accounts, but each one must keep doing distinct, checked work every epoch to hold any weight, so the upkeep cost scales with every fake, while honest agents build a basalt-solid record over time.
